SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.ACTIVITY_ID, M.MATCHING_NO, M.USER_NO, M.MATCHING_TITLE, M.MATCHING_CONTENT, M.CREATED_AT, M.UPDATED_AT, M.MATCHING_LOCATION, M.MATCHING_DATE, M.MATCHING_LEVEL, M.MATCHING_TIME, M.PARTNER_TYPE, M.MATCHING_TYPE, TO_CHAR(M.MATCHING_PRICE, '999,999,999') AS MATCHING_PRICE, A.ACTIVITY_NAME, U.USER_NICKNAME, M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL A WHERE A.MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO) AS APPLICATION_COUNT,
(SELECT IMG_PATH || '/' || IMG_RENAME FROM USER_PROFILE_IMG_TBL WHERE USER_NO = M.USER_NO AND IMG_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS USER_PROFILE_IMG,
CASE -- 1. [마감] 날짜가 지났을 경우 WHEN TO_DATE(M.MATCHING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '마감'
-- 2. [마감] 오늘 날짜지만 시간이 지났을 경우 WHEN M.MATCHING_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND M.MATCHING_TIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') THEN '마감'
-- 3. [마감] 신청 인원이 모집 인원과 같거나 많을 경우 WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO) >= M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT THEN '마감'
-- 4. [마감임박] (날짜가 2일 이내) AND (남은 자리가 2자리 이하) WHEN (TO_DATE(M.MATCHING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN 0 AND 2) OR (M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO) <= 2) THEN '마감임박'
-- 5. [모집중] 그 외 나머지 ELSE '모집중' END AS MATCHING_STATUS
FROM MATCHING_TBL M JOIN ACTIVITY_TBL A ON M.ACTIVITY_ID = A.ACTIVITY_ID JOIN USER_TBL U ON M.USER_NO = U.USER_NO
WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.COMMUNITY_NO, C.COMMUNITY_TITLE, C.COMMUNITY_TYPE, C.CREATED_AT, C.VIEW_COUNT, C.UPDATED_AT, C.DELETE_YN, U.USER_NICKNAME AS userNickName,
(SELECT IMG_PATH || '/' || IMG_RENAME FROM USER_PROFILE_IMG_TBL WHERE USER_NO = C.USER_NO AND IMG_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS USER_PROFILE_IMG, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_BOARD_LIKE BL WHERE BL.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_TBL CT WHERE CT.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO ) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM COMMUNITY_TBL C LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON C.USER_NO = U.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_BOARD_LIKE B ON C.COMMUNITY_NO = B.COMMUNITY_NO WHERE C.COMMUNITY_TYPE != 'success' AND C.DELETE_YN = 'N' GROUP BY C.COMMUNITY_NO, C.COMMUNITY_TITLE, C.COMMUNITY_TYPE, C.CREATED_AT, C.DELETE_YN, C.VIEW_COUNT, C.UPDATED_AT, C.USER_NO, U.USER_NICKNAME ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.COMMUNITY_NO, C.COMMUNITY_TITLE, C.VIEW_COUNT, C.CREATED_AT, C.GOAL_DATE, C.SUCCESS_TYPE, C.DELETE_YN, U.USER_NICKNAME AS USER_NICKNAME,
(SELECT IMG_PATH || '/' || IMG_RENAME FROM USER_PROFILE_IMG_TBL WHERE USER_NO = C.USER_NO AND IMG_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS USER_PROFILE_IMG, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR( REGEXP_REPLACE( REPLACE(C.COMMUNITY_CONTENT, ' ', ''), '<[^>]*>' , '' ), 100, 1 ) AS COMMUNITY_CONTENT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_BOARD_LIKE BL WHERE BL.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_TBL CT WHERE CT.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO ) AS COMMENT_COUNT, (SELECT I.IMG_PATH FROM COMMUNITY_IMG_TBL I WHERE I.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS THUMBNAIL FROM COMMUNITY_TBL C JOIN USER_TBL U ON C.USER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE C.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND C.COMMUNITY_TYPE = 'success' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NOTICE_NO, NOTICE_TITLE, NOTICE_CATEGORY, VIEW_COUNT, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-mm-dd') AS CREATEDDAY FROM NOTICE_TBL ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
